entries.brief: Original SKAZ fantasy bestiary painterly realism, isolated head and chest of an undead WARHORSE SKELETON. Anatomically accurate equine skull with long nasal bone, large empty eye sockets and horse teeth, cervical vertebrae, shoulder bones and ribcage. NO ears at all, NO bone ears, NO horns, no antlers, no skin, no mane. Only dry bones and a few loose remnants of simple faded cloth horse barding. Clear compact portrait at32px, neutral ivory bones modeled with gray shadows, transparent background, no ground or fog, entire skull and neck inside generous margins.

entries.brief: SKAZ bestiary portrait, a realistic natural brown weasel sitting upright, close-up HEAD AND CHEST ONLY, tiny round ears, long narrow mustelid face, alert black eyes, pink nose, white throat. Mature hand-painted fantasy natural history illustration matching a medieval bestiary. Crisp fur outline. A single isolated animal portrait cutout on a fully transparent background. No full body, no tail, no fog, no halo, no glow, no shadow behind animal, no vignette, no floor. Centered small portrait with generous margins. Gray shadows model white throat so it reads on cream UI. No accessories or text.
